title: Quality Crumbly American Sausage Skillet
description: A cultured and energizing American dish featuring crumbly sausage, this skillet is perfect for a weeknight dinner, it is nut-free-friendly and made with papillote style cooking.
instructions: Cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the sausage is browned, remove it from the skillet and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and potato to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cooked sausage back into the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Cut the papillote paper into a large square and place the sausage and vegetable mixture in the center of the paper.
Fold the papillote paper over the mixture to create a sealed packet.
Place the packet in the skillet and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Remove the packet from the skillet and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
